original.desc: Output from ASHS (Automated Segmentation of Hippocampal Subfields) in ITKSNAP format

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Inspecting or reusing the full ASHS hippocampal subfield output.

**Not for:** Direct use as a parcellation; use the neuro/parcellation/volume output of the same App. Sharing without checking for copies of the input whole-head images in the working directory.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 3 (directly identifiable or traceable) by default.

**Apps:** output of 1 App.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.ashs.json
